description: Render a weather map or chart image for visual analysis: `kind: map` draws `select` layers (radar, satellite, outlooks, alerts and storm features overlaid) at `location` or `bbox`, and `kind: sounding` draws the nearest radiosonde as a skew-T and hodograph chart. With no `select` the map draws `precipitation_hybrid` (observed radar precipitation in the place's domain); `at` picks the closest frame, `filter` narrows feature overlays, `area` draws an outline, and search_data finds products. Example: {"kind": "map", "location": "Tulsa, OK", "select": ["nexrad_l3:TLX:N0S", "weather_alert"], "filter": ["event == Tornado Warning"], "zoom": 8}.

area.description: Map: an outline over the layers, by reference or inline; with no location or bbox, the extent.

filter.description: Its features to outline, as `filter` expressions.

product.description: A boundary product (get_context include boundaries names one), with feature_id, feature_ids or filter.

at.description: Map: RFC 3339 instant with an offset; each layer draws its closest frame (default: latest). A forecast layer honors a future time.

bbox.description: Map extent [west, south, east, north] in degrees, instead of location and zoom.

filter.description: Map: narrows feature overlays declaring the property, e.g. "event == Tornado Warning": `<property> <op> <value>`, op == != > >= < <= in (a comma list).

kind.description: map: weather layers over a basemap; sounding: the nearest radiosonde as a skew-T and hodograph chart.

location.description: Map center or sounding place: place text, ZIP or `lat,lon`; not with bbox.

select.description: Map layers, bottom to top (at most 6): a product id with a map, a standard_name (the finest-step layer reaching at), a catalog pick <family>:<pick>[:<pick>] over a layer's axes (satellite:13, satellite:water_vapor, satellite:2:goes_west, composite:reflectivity), a feature product (alerts, storm cells, reports) over the rasters, or one radar site as nexrad_l3:{SITE}:{KEY}, KEY N0B reflectivity, N0S storm-relative velocity (rotation), N0G base velocity, N0C correlation coefficient, N0X differential reflectivity. Default precipitation_hybrid.

units.description: Sounding axis and indices: imperial (default, °F) or metric (°C); keys end in their unit.

zoom.description: Map zoom with location, 2-14: 5 regional, 8 metro, 10 city (default 7).

name: render

indices.description: Sounding: derived indices (CAPE, CIN, lifted index, PWAT, shear, LCL).

layers.description: Map: each layer drawn, with its valid time or why it was skipped.

open_map_url.description: Map: the interactive map at this view.

overlays.description: Map: each feature overlay, with the features it drew when read here (0: none matched in view).

resolved.description: Map: per standard_name in select, the layer drawn (finest step that reaches the time), its step (ISO duration) and how far its frames reach, an instant: ahead_to for a forecast (its last frame), back_to for an observed layer (its first frame; its newest is the latest observed), the finer layers passed over (passed: their ahead_to is before the time) and the other layers drawing the name here (others).

title: Render
